questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Diwali sweets were being prepared by our grandmother.

options.text: Our grandmother was preparing Diwali sweets.
Our grandmother is preparing Diwali sweets.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Our grandmother was preparing Diwali sweets.**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and we need to change it into the active form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the passive form of the **past continuous tense**.
 
• The past continuous tense in the passive voice has the following structure: **Object+ was/were +being+V3+ by + subject__**
 
• The past continuous tense in the active voice has the following structure: **__Subject + was/were + v1+ing+ object__**
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Passive voice - The wall was being painted by Rahul.
 
• Active voice - Rahul was painting the wall.
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct Active Voice: *Our grandmother was preparing Diwali sweets.*

Net change in total weight = Total members × Increase in average

Net change = 8 × 2 = 16 kg

Weight of new man = Weight of replaced man + Net change

Weight of new man = 90 + 16 = 106 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 106 kg.**
